decision.observation: 0 mph, gear still R, red X lit. The car has rolled back a little and sits on the grass just left of the tarmac, nose up-screen, with a tall pine on its left, barrels behind-right and the boulder well ahead. The lane is immediately to screen-right and curves up and right with puddles.
decision.hypothesis: The last W+D only cancelled the reverse roll. The front is now clear, so another short W+D should swing the nose onto the tarmac to the right.
decision.memory: After a reverse, the first forward hold may only cancel the backward roll and leave the gear at R. A second short hold is needed to actually move forward.
